reviews.observation: Owner research plus independent pinned-source/model review found no central contradiction in the explicitly reduced scope; model invariants and numerical timing dependencies pass.

Concrete A/B prompt and device-pending cells expose why partial prefill emits nothing; architecture cooperates rather than presenting subsystems as alternatives. Tradeoff diagram retains true dependencies and labeled assumed units.
Owner-operated production browser reproduced and closed the three independent P2 findings;22 grouped journeys include48 timing selections,9 budget oracles and real document reloads.

Owner and independent screenshot review across languages and widths;18 actual rendered cases have no checked overflow or KaTeX errors. Clean viewport captures supplement sticky-header artifacts in full-page images.

Shared metadata/learning/sharing check passes13 chapters; actual Home return, share restoration and production assets were exercised. No unrelated chapter contract changed. Native screenshot format and suffix agreement verified after a real-tool JPEG compatibility correction;18 helper tests pass.

findings.description: Timing IDs lacked track identity and selected the wrong diagram's interval.
Decode scheduling reused prefill instructions/source and did not highlight decoded input.
Removed/excluded request selection could mismatch the row and active-batch narrative.
Architecture input IDs were static for the four-request scenario.
Narrow timing segments lacked a sufficiently usable equivalent selection control/legend.
Evidence transport assumed PNG although browser returned native JPEG. Captures renamed without byte changes; validator supports PNG/JPEG framing and matching extensions.
